verdict.rationale: Termius is an SSH client with cloud-synced team vaults, so a public API with a machine-readable spec is a fair thing to ask for. However, nothing in the evidence documents an API or spec, and the probe found every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404. The llms.txt file that does exist is a documentation index, not an API spec, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
